升阶（8环级） 你的战斗形态为巨型，你的飞行速度+20尺状态加值、并且你的攻击具有10尺触及（如果本来为10尺触及则为15尺）。你改为获得AC=21+你的等级、15临时生命、攻击调整值+28、伤害加值+12、以及运动+28。你的龙息额外造成4d6伤害。

Repulsion.name: 排斥术 Repulsion
Repulsion.description:
你创造一个令生物无法接近你的灵光。当施放该法术时，你可以令区域为任何你所选择的半径，至多40尺。当你施放该法术时位于区域中的生物，以及在法术生效时进入该区域的生物必须尝试一次意志豁免。生物尝试过该豁免后，对于这次施放的排斥术总使用相同的结果。仅当生物自愿向你移动时，任何对其的移动限制才会生效。例如，如果你移动靠近一个生物，它不需要走远。

大成功 该生物的移动不受影响。

成功 该生物移动靠近你时，将区域中的每一格视为困难地形。

失败 在该区域中，该生物无法移动靠近你。

Chromatic Wall.name: 色彩之墙 Chromatic Wall
Chromatic Wall.description:
你创造一个由某种鲜艳光芒组成的不透明墙壁。墙壁形状笔直并垂直地面，长60尺高30尺。如果墙壁会穿过生物，你失去该法术。墙壁在两侧产生20尺明亮光照，在后续20尺产生昏暗光照。你可以无视该墙的效果。

骰[[/r 1d4]]，决定墙壁的颜色。每个颜色对于尝试穿过的物品，效果或者生物都有特定效果。七彩法墙无法被常规反制；但是每个颜色会在被特定法术作为目标是自动反制，即使该法术的环级低于七彩法墙。

  1. 1 红色 该墙摧毁穿过的远程武器弹药（例如箭和弩矢），并对任何穿过墙壁的目标造成@Damage[20[fire]]伤害，这有一次@Check[reflex|against:spell|basic]豁免。@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.3puDanGfpEt6jK5k]{寒冰锥 Cone of Cold}能反制红色七彩法墙。
  2. 2 橙色 该墙摧毁穿过的投掷武器，并对任何穿过墙壁的目标造成@Damage[25[acid]]伤害，这有一次@Check[reflex|against:spell|basic]豁免。@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.g8QqHpv2CWDwmIm1]{造风术 Gust of Wind}能反制橙色七彩法墙。
  3. 3 黄色 该墙阻挡酸，寒冷，电击，力场，虚能，命能以及音波效果，并对任何穿过墙壁的目标造成@Damage[30[electricity]]伤害，这有一次@Check[reflex|against:spell|basic]豁免。@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r7ihOgKv19eJQnik]{解离术 Disintegrate}能反制黄色七彩法墙。
  4. 4 绿色 该墙阻挡毒气，气体，以及喷吐武器。对任何穿过墙壁的目标造成@Damage[10[poison]]伤害，并使它们获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭 Enfeebled 1}，持续1分钟。@Check[fortitude|against:spell|basic]豁免可以减少伤害，并且在成功时无效力竭效果。@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.115Xp9E38CJENhNS]{通墙术 Magic Passage}能反制绿色七彩法墙。

升阶（7环级） 该法术的持续时间增加到1小时。投掷[[/r 1d8]]来决定墙壁的颜色；对于5-8的结果如下所述。@Damage[30[fire]]{红色}，@Damage[35[acid]]{橙色}，@Damage[40[electricity]]{黄色}或者@Damage[20[poison]]{绿色}的墙造成额外10伤害。

  1. 5 蓝色 该墙壁阻挡听觉，石化，以及视觉效果，并且穿过墙壁的目标会承受@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.znv4ECL7ZtuiagtA]{石化术 Petrify}的效果。@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{力场飞弹 Force Barrage}能反制蓝色七彩法墙。
  2. 6 靛蓝 该墙阻挡预言和心灵效果，并且穿过墙壁的目标会承受@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8kJbiBEjMWG4VUjs]{心灵扭曲 Warp Mind}的效果。@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.DyiD239dNS7RIxZE]{灼热圣光 Holy Light}能反制 靛蓝七彩法墙。
  3. 7 紫色 该墙阻挡法术从对面指定目标（区域效果如常穿过）。穿过墙壁的生物需进行@Check[will|against:spell]检定，失败时承受@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 Slowed 1}，持续1分钟；在大失败时，该生物改为如@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5bTt2CvYHPvaR7QQ]{跨界传送 Interplanar Teleport}的效果被送往其他位面。@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]能反制紫色七彩法墙。
  4. 8 重骰，并且穿过该墙的生物在豁免上承受-2环境减值。

Cloak of Colors.name: 色彩斗篷 Cloak of Colors
Cloak of Colors.description:
颜色旋转变幻的披风覆盖在目标身上。相邻的生物会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]，并且攻击目标时会产生强烈的闪光。当一个生物通过近战攻击命中目标时，必须尝试一次意志豁免。

成功 攻击者不受影响。

失败 攻击者@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]1轮。

大失败 攻击者被@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]1轮。该生物暂时免疫，直到其回合结束；该效果具有失能特征。

Dragon Wings.name: 龙翼 Dragon Wings
Dragon Wings.description:
你的背后生出一对坚韧的翅膀，给予你60尺或者等同于你移动速度的飞行速度，以较快者为准。当法术持续时间结束时，如果你仍在飞行，则在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TTwOKGqmZeKSyNMH]的效果下飘落到地上。

升阶（8环级） 持续时间增加至10分钟。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.jy4edd6pvJvJgOSP]

Summon Dragon.name: 召唤巨龙 Summon Dragon
Summon Dragon.description:
你召唤一个具有龙特征的生物为你而战，其等级为5或更低。如果该龙具有魔法根源特征（奥术、神术、异能、原能），你必须使用对应的根源来施放召唤巨龙才能召唤它。

升阶 如@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.journals.JournalEntry.S55aqwWIzpQRFhcq.JournalEntryPage.8gcp880pEWZ9VPnF]{召唤 summon}特征列出。

Confusion.name: 困惑术 Confusion
Confusion.description:
你使用奇怪的能量波动扰乱了目标的思维，令其随机行动。法术效果由目标的意志豁免决定。你可以解消该法术。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标胡言乱语，并且获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 Stunned 1}。

失败 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{困惑 Confused}1分钟。在其每个回合结束，它能尝试一次新豁免来结束困惑术。

大失败 目标困惑1分钟，并且没有提前结束的豁免。

升阶（8环级） 你能以至多10个生物为目标。

Unfettered Movement.name: 行动无碍 Unfettered Movement
Unfettered Movement.description:
你驱散可能影响一个生物的阻碍。当处于该法术效果中时，法术目标忽视会赋予其速度环境减值的效果。当法术目标尝试@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}一个令其@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}、@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}或者@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}的效果时，它自动成功，除非该效果是魔法性的，并且其环级比行动无碍更高。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.CdAyAiMGESvgNQtz]{Spell Effect: Unfettered Movement}

Spell Immunity.name: 法术免疫 Spell Immunity
Spell Immunity.description: 你保护目标免受一个法术的效果影响。选择一个法术，作为语言成分的一部分大声念出其名称。每当法术免疫的目标成为所念出名字的法术的目标或者处于该法术的区域内时，法术免疫会尝试反制该法术。通过法术免疫成功反制以区域为目标或者具有数个目标的法术时，仅取消对法术免疫所影响的目标的效果。

Wall of Fire.name: 火墙术 Wall of Fire
Wall of Fire.description:
你令一面熊熊燃烧的火墙拔地而起，其能灼烧穿越墙体的生物。你可以创造5尺厚的直线形火墙，至多60尺长，10尺高；或是高度相同，但5尺厚，10尺半径的环状火墙。该墙体无论哪种形态均以竖直姿态矗立；只要你愿意，所创造墙体的长度与高度均可以更短。火墙一侧的任何事物对于另一侧的生物而言均为@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}。任何穿过该墙体，或者在其回合开始时占据墙体区域的生物承受4d6点火焰伤害。

升阶（+1）该火焰伤害增加1d6。

Dragon Breath (Brass).name: 龙息（黄铜） Dragon Breath (Brass)
Dragon Breath (Brass).description:
你从口中喷吐出能量，在60尺线性范围内造成5d6点火焰伤害，基础反射豁免。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加2d6点。

Fireball.name: 火球术 Fireball
Fireball.description:
在你指定的位置爆发出咆哮的烈焰，造成6d6火焰伤害。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加2d6。

Haste.name: 加速术 Haste
Haste.description:
魔法强化了目标，令其行动迅速。它获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}状态，并且每轮可以使用该额外动作以打击或者行走。

升阶（7环级） 你能以至多6个生物为目标。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.ElkXovNrHB0Doi6O]{法术效果：加速术}

Haste (DFMD).name: Haste
Haste (DFMD).description:
Magic empowers the target to act faster. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition and can use the extra action each round only for Strike and Stride actions.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 6 creatures.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ElkXovNrHB0Doi6O]{Spell Effect: Haste}

Lightning Bolt.name: 闪电束 Lightning Bolt
Lightning Bolt.description:
一束闪电从你手中绽放而出，造成4d12电击伤害。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加1d12。

Blur.name: 朦胧术 Blur
Blur.description: 目标的形态变得模糊不清。它获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}。由于该效果的原理，目标的位置仍然是显然的，目标不能使用该隐蔽来躲藏或潜行。

Mirror Image.name: 镜影术 Mirror Image
Mirror Image.description:
三个你的幻象影像在你的空间周围盘旋，可能使那些攻击你的人改为击中其中一个影像，而不是你。任何本会命中你的攻击，都会有一定的随机几率改为命中你的一个影像而非你。如果三个影像都还存在，则有 1/4 的几率命中你（[[/r 1d4]] 掷出 1）。若还剩两个影像，则有 1/3 的几率命中你（[[/r 1d6]] 掷出 1–2）。若只剩一个影像，则几率为 1/2（[[/r 1d6]] 掷出 1–3）。

一旦某个影像被命中，它就会被摧毁。如果一次攻击掷骰未能命中你的 AC，但也没有大失败，则会摧毁一个影像，但不会产生额外效果（即使该攻击通常会在失败时产生某种效果）。如果一次攻击掷骰为大成功，且本会命中某个影像，则会摧毁其中一个影像，且该攻击掷骰改为对你成功。当所有影像都被摧毁后，该法术结束。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.0PO5mFRhh9HxGAtv]{Spell Effect: 镜影术}

Resist Energy.name: 抵抗能量伤害 Resist Energy
Resist Energy.description:
元素护盾保护一个生物免受某一种类型能量的伤害。选择酸蚀，寒冷，电击，火焰或者音波伤害。目标和其装备获得对你所选择伤害类型的抗力5。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.con2Hzt47JjpuUej]{法术效果：抵抗能量伤害}

升阶（4环级） 该抗力增加到10，并且你能以至多两个生物为目标。

升阶（7环级） 该抗力增加到15，并且你能以至多五个生物为目标。

Stupefy.name: 愚者之思 Stupefy
Stupefy.description:
你令目标精神迟钝，基于其意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 1}，持续1分钟。

失败 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 2}，持续1分钟。

大失败 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 3}，持续1分钟。

Acid Splash.name: 酸液飞溅 Acid Splash
Acid Splash.description:
你泼出一团酸液，溅到你的目标和附近的生物身上。进行一次法术攻击。若命中，你造成 1d6 点强酸伤害外加 1 点溅射强酸伤害。若大成功，目标还会受到 @Damage[(ceil(@item.level/2))[persistent,acid]] 伤害。

升阶（3环） 初始伤害提高至 2d6，且持续伤害提高至 2。

升阶（5环） 初始伤害提高至 3d6，持续伤害提高至 3，且溅射伤害提高至 2。

升阶（7环） 初始伤害提高至 4d6，持续伤害提高至 4，且溅射伤害提高至 3。

升阶（9环） 初始伤害提高至 5d6，持续伤害提高至 5，且溅射伤害提高至 4。

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你发出一阵脉冲，以感知魔法的存在。除了魔法是否存在之外，你不会获得任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你和盟友身上的魔法物品与持续中的法术。只有当幻术魔法的效果环阶低于你的侦测魔法法术环阶时，你才能探测到该幻术魔法。不过，具有幻术灵光但外观并不具有欺骗性的物品（例如 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.bikFUFRLwfdvX2x2]{隐形药水}）通常仍会被正常探测到。

强化（3环）你会得知该法术所探测到的最强魔法效果的环阶或等级，由GM判定。

强化（4环）如3环，但你还会锁定最高环阶魔法的来源。与非精确感官类似，你不会得知确切位置，但可以将来源缩小到5尺立方体范围内（若其大于此范围，则为最近的一个5尺立方体）。

Flurry of Claws.name: 疾风爪击 Flurry of Claws
Flurry of Claws.description:
一对凶猛的龙爪出现并砍向附近的两个敌人。对每个目标各进行1次法术攻击骰对抗其AC。在计算你的多重攻击减值时这会被计为2次攻击，但是这些减值在你作出这2次攻击之后才会增加。命中时，生物受到1d8挥砍与1d4额外伤害。额外伤害的种类由你影响了你血统的龙类所关联的魔法根源决定：奥术 力场；神术 精魂；异能 心灵；原能 火焰。

升阶（+1） 初始伤害增加1d8点，额外伤害增加1d4点。

Fear.name: 恐惧术 Fear
Fear.description:
你将恐惧植入目标；它必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 1}.

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 2}.

大失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 3} 并且 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑 Fleeing} 1轮.

升阶（3环级） 你能以至多五个生物为目标。

Light.name: 光 Light
Light.description:
你创造一个光球，它发出由你选择的颜色的光芒，在20尺半径内产生明亮光照（以及接下来的20尺产生昏暗光照）。如果你在一个自愿的生物身上施法，你可以将光球连结到该生物，这使得光球会跟随该生物一起移动。你可以维持法术以移动光球至多60尺，作为这个移动的一部分，你可以将光球连结到一个生物或是从一个生物上解除连结。

你可以解消该法术。如果你在你已经有4个光亮术激活时施放该法术的话，你必须结束一个已存在的法术。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{法术效果：光亮术}

升阶（4环级） 光球在60尺半径内产生明亮光照（并在接下来的60尺产生昏暗光照）。

Enfeeble.name: 衰弱术 Enfeeble
Enfeeble.description:
你抽走目标的力量，基于其强韧豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭 Enfeebled 1}，直到你的下个回合开始。

失败 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭 Enfeebled 2}，持续1分钟。

大失败 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭 Enfeebled 3}，持续1分钟

Shield.name: 护盾 Shield
Shield.description:
你升起一面魔法力场护盾。这视为使用“举起护盾”动作，使你获得 AC +1 的处境加值，直到你的下一回合开始，但使用它不需要占用一只手。

当该法术效果持续期间，你可以用你的魔法护盾使用 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} 反应。该护盾的硬度为 5。你可以使用该法术的反应来减少任何法术或魔法效果造成的伤害，即使其不造成物理伤害也是如此。在你使用 Shield Block 后，该法术结束，且你在 10 分钟内无法再次施放它。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{法术效果：护盾}

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{效果：护盾免疫}

升阶（+2） 护盾的硬度提高 5。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

Telekinetic Projectile.name: 念动射弹 Telekinetic Projectile
Telekinetic Projectile.description:
你向目标射出区域中一个未固定的，无主的，1负载1以下的物体。对目标尝试一次法术攻击骰。如果你命中，你造成2d6的钝击，穿刺，或者挥砍伤害（对应于你所扔出的物体）。射出物体的特殊特征或者魔法特性不会影响该攻击或者伤害。

大成功 你造成双倍伤害。

成功 你造成完整伤害。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加1d6。

Sure Strike.name: 料敌机先 Sure Strike
Sure Strike.description:
在你的回合结束前，你下一次尝试攻击骰时，骰两次并使用较好的结果。该攻击会忽视对攻击骰的环境减值，以及其他任何目标@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}或者@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}所导致的纯骰检定。然后你临时免疫料敌机先10分钟。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.fpGDAz2v5PG0zUSl]{Spell Effect: Sure Strike}

Bo Staff.name: 棍 Bo Staff
Bo Staff.description: This strong but slender staff is tapered at the ends and well balanced. It's designed to be an offensive and defensive weapon.

Glue Bomb (Greater).name: 高等胶水弹 Glue Bomb (Greater)
Glue Bomb (Greater).description:
启动 1 打击

黏胶炸弹是一种无害的爆破装置，里面装满了黏性物质。当你用黏胶炸弹命中一名生物时，这名生物会在速度上承受持续1分钟的-15尺状态减值。你在攻击骰上获得+2的物品加值，且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]DC为[[/act escape dc=28]]{28}。

一旦攻击造成重击，与固体表面接触的目标生物将会被定在表面上并陷入持续1轮的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]状态，如果是通过翅膀飞行的生物则会被缠住翅膀，导致它安全地落在地上并且1轮内不能再度起飞。黏胶炸弹对那些身处水中的生物没有效果。

目标能够花费累计3个交互动作来小心地移除黏性物质或进行逃脱，从而结束黏胶炸弹的效果。这些交互动作不必是连续的，其他生物也能提供这些交互动作。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.sgQknR94qDt5ILBx]

Explorer's Clothing.name: 探险者衣装 Explorer's Clothing
Explorer's Clothing.description: 不穿护甲的冒险家穿着耐用的衣服旅行。虽然它不是护甲并且应用你的无甲防御熟练，但它仍然有一个敏捷上限，而且如果蚀刻了潜能符文，也可以在AC上提供物品加值。

Nagaji Venom.name: 娜迦毒液 Nagaji Venom
Nagaji Venom.description:
豁免 @Check[fortitude|dc:25]

最大持续时间 6 轮

阶段1 @Damage[2d6[poison]]伤害（1轮）

阶段2 @Damage[3d6[poison]]伤害和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩 Dazzled}（1轮）

阶段3 @Damage[4d6[poison]]伤害和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲 Blinded}（1轮）

Quickened Casting.name: 快速施法 Quickened Casting
Quickened Casting.description: 如果亚彬的下一个动作是施展一个术士戏法，或者是不高于5环级的术士法术，他将其施法动作减少1个（最少为1个动作）。

Steady Spellcasting.name: 稳定施法 Steady Spellcasting
Steady Spellcasting.description: 你对自己的施法技术充满自信，你不会轻易失去法术。如果一个反应动作会打断你的施法动作，尝试一次@Check[flat|showDC:all|dc:15]检定。如果成功，你的动作不会被打断。

Command.name: 命令术 Command
Command.description:
你喊出一句难以被忽视的命令。你可以命令目标接近你，逃离你（如同获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑 Fleeing}状态），扔下持有物，俯卧@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}，或者站立在原地。它不能@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.A72nHGUtNXgY5Ey9]{延后 Delay}或者使用任何反应动作，直到它服从你的命令为止。法术效果基于目标的意志豁免。

成功 目标不受影响。

失败 作为该生物下个回合的第一个动作，其必须用一个单动作来完成你的命令。

大失败 目标必须使用其下个回合的全部动作来完成你的命令。

升阶（5环级） 你能以至多10个生物为目标。

Earthbind.name: 地缚术 Earthbind
Earthbind.description:
你使用大地的重量以干扰目标的飞行能力，其效果基于强韧豁免。如果该生物安全到达地面，它不会承受坠落伤害。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标安全坠落至多120尺。

失败 目标安全坠落至多120尺。如果它碰到地面，它1轮内不能飞行，浮空或者以其他方式离开地面。

大失败 目标安全坠落至多120尺。如果它碰到地面，它1分钟内不能飞行，浮空或者以其他方式离开地面。

Force Barrage.name: 力场飞弹 Force Barrage
Force Barrage.description:
你发射出一道固态的魔力碎片，射向一个你能看见的生物。它自动命中，并造成1d4+1力场伤害。你施放该法术时每额外使用一个动作，你射出的碎片增加一个，最大为3个动作发射三个碎片。你为每个碎片分别选择目标。如果你对同一个目标射击超过1个碎片，将伤害合计后再计算伤害加值，减值，抗力，弱点等。

升阶（+2） 你花费的每个动作额外射出一枚碎片。

Slow.name: 缓慢术 Slow
Slow.description:
你令目标周围的时间膨胀，令其行动缓慢。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 Slowed 1} ，持续1轮。

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 Slowed 1}，持续1分钟。

大失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 Slowed 2}，持续1分钟。

升阶（6环级） 你能以至多10个生物为目标。

Cone of Cold.name: 寒冰锥 Cone of Cold
Cone of Cold.description:
冰冷的寒流从你的手掌中喷出。你对区域内的每个生物造成12d6寒冷伤害。基础反射豁免。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加2d6。

Melodic Squall.name: Melodic Squall
Melodic Squall.publicNotes: This cloud of song and sound has been caught by the wind and carried across the air. While the melody on the wind might enjoy the beauty of music, it is by nature a destructive elemental force.

Hostile Duet.name: Hostile Duet
Hostile Duet.description:
Trigger A hostile creature within 30 feet creates an effect with the auditory trait that provides bonuses to itself or its allies

Effect The melodic squall recreates the auditory effect, gaining the bonuses for itself and its allies as long as the original effect persists.

Retune.name: Retune
Retune.description:
Trigger The melodic squall is targeted by a spell with the auditory trait

Effect The melodic squall attempts to counteract the spell with a @Check[performance] check. If it succeeds, the spell effect is caught in a blast of wind that sweeps it back to its origin, affecting the caster. Targets of the triggering effect other than the melody on the wind are still affected normally.

Mesmerizing Melody.name: Mesmerizing Melody
Mesmerizing Melody.description:
The melodic squall sings in a sonorous chorus. Any creature in a @Template[emanation|distance:30] must attempt a @Check[will|dc:36] save to resist becoming fascinated by the melody on the wind. A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune for 24 hours.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{fascinated} for 4 rounds.

Subsonic Burst.name: Subsonic Burst
Subsonic Burst.description:
The melodic squall focuses intense sound at an inaudible frequency in a @Template[line|distance:100]. Each creature in the line must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:34] save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} until the beginning of the melodic squall's next turn.

Swiftness.name: Swiftness
Swiftness.description: The melodic squall's movement doesn't trigger reactions.

Portal Eater.name: Portal Eater
Portal Eater.allSaves: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

Eat Portal.name: Eat Portal
Eat Portal.description:
Requirements The portal eater's beak is not grabbing a creature

Trigger A creature teleports or is summoned within 50 feet of the portal eater

Effect The portal eater attempts to eat the portal. It makes a counteract check against the effect (counteract modifier +33, counteract rank 9th). If the effect is counteracted, the creature arrives in the portal eater's beak and the portal eater @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.Tkd8sH4pwFIPzqTr]{Grabs} it.

Enormous.name: Enormous
Enormous.description: A portal eater is a massive creature and takes up a space of 10 squares by 10 squares (50 feet by 50 feet).

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

Reflect Spell.name: Reflect Spell
Reflect Spell.description:
Trigger A creature Casts a Spell that targets the portal eater

Effect The portal eater attempts to counteract the spell (counteract modifier +32, counteract rank 9th). If the spell is counteracted, it targets the caster instead.

Unfurl Realities.name: Unfurl Realities
Unfurl Realities.description: The portal eater unfurls its crystalline cloak of stolen realities, releasing a wave of cosmic energy and casting @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.d6o52BnjViNz7Gub]{Prismatic Spray} (DC 39) in a @Template[emanation|distance:60]. The portal eater can't Unfurl Realities again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Unfurl Realities]]{1d4 rounds}.

Unfathomable Song.name: Unfathomable Song
Unfathomable Song.description:
Fleeting notes of a strange and unnatural song fill the air, overtaking the mind. Each target must attempt a Will save when you cast the spell, and again the first time you Sustain this Spell each round. A creature needs to attempt only one save against the song each round, and you have to keep the same targets when you Sustain the Spell.

Critical Success The target is unaffected, can't be affected on subsequent rounds, and is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Success The target is unaffected this round, but it can be affected on subsequent rounds.

Failure Roll 1d4 on the table below.

Critical Failure Roll 1d4+1 on the table below.

Result Effect
1 The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}
2 The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round
3 The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 4} for 1 round
4 The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round
5 The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned} for 1 round and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for an unlimited duration

Wail of the Banshee.name: Wail of the Banshee
Wail of the Banshee.description:
Your scream chills the souls of enemies that hear it. Each living enemy in the area takes 8d10 void damage and must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes full damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained} [[/r 1d4]].

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 4}.

Disappearance.name: Disappearance
Disappearance.description: You shroud a creature from others' senses. The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, but not merely to vision. The invisibility granted by disappearance applies to all precise senses an observer might have. It's still possible for a creature to find the target by Seeking using various senses, looking for disturbed dust, hearing gaps in the sound spectrum, or finding some other way to discover the presence of a creature that is otherwise undetectable.

Spirit Song.name: Spirit Song
Spirit Song.description:
Your eldritch song sends pulsing waves of ethereal energy to attack creatures' spirits in the area, dealing 18d6 force damage. Because spirit song affects creatures' spirits, it can damage a target projecting its consciousness (such as via project image) or possessing another creature even if the target's body is elsewhere. The vibrating waves of spiritual song penetrate into, but not through, solid barriers, damaging incorporeal creatures hiding in solid objects in the area but not passing onward to damage creatures in other rooms. Possessed creatures aren't harmed by the song. The song doesn't harm creatures that have no spirit, such as constructs.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Uncontrollable Dance.name: Uncontrollable Dance
Uncontrollable Dance.description:
The target is overcome with an all-consuming urge to dance. For the duration of the spell, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} and can't use reactions. While affected, the creature can't use actions with the move trait except to dance, using the Stride action to move up to half its Speed.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The spell's duration is 3 rounds, and the target must spend at least 1 action each turn dancing.

Failure The spell's duration is 1 minute, and the target must spend at least 2 actions each turn dancing.

Critical Failure The spell's duration is 1 minute, and the target must spend all its actions each turn dancing.

Collective Transposition.name: Collective Transposition
Collective Transposition.description:
You teleport the targets to new positions within the area. The creatures must each be able to fit in their new space, and their positions must be unoccupied, entirely within the area, and in your line of sight. Unwilling creatures can attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target can teleport if it wants, but it chooses the destination within range.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure You teleport the target and choose its destination.

Heightened (+1) The number of targets increases by 1.

Mislead.name: Mislead
Mislead.description:
You turn yourself @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} and create an illusory duplicate of yourself. When you Sustain the Spell, you can mentally dictate a course of action for your duplicate to follow that round. Your duplicate acts as though it had your full number of actions, though it can't actually affect anything in the environment. Both the duplicate and your invisibility persist for the spell's duration. Performing a hostile action doesn't end mislead's invisibility, just like a 4th-rank invisibility spell. A creature that determines the duplicate is an illusion doesn't necessarily know you're invisible, and one that can see your invisible form doesn't necessarily know your duplicate is an illusion.

If you Cast a Spell, attack, or otherwise interact with another creature, as a part of that action you can attempt a Deception check against observers' Perception DCs to convince them your duplicate used that action. This doesn't fool anyone who's aware your duplicate is an illusion, nor does it work if the attack obviously couldn't have come from the duplicate. For instance, if you fired a ray, you could make it look like it came from the duplicate as long as the duplicate was positioned appropriately, but if you attacked with a sword and your duplicate was across the room from the target, your Deception check would automatically fail.

Wall of Force.name: Wall of Force
Wall of Force.description:
You form an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} wall of pure magical force up to 50 feet long and up to 20 feet high. The wall has no discernible thickness. You must create the wall in an unbroken open space so its edges don't pass through any creatures or objects, or the spell is lost. The wall has AC 10, Hardness 30, and 60 Hit Points, and it's immune to critical hits and precision damage. The wall blocks physical effects from passing through it, and because it's made of force, it blocks incorporeal and ethereal creatures as well. Teleportation effects can pass through the barrier, as can visual effects (since the wall is invisible). Wall of force is immune to counteracting effects of its level or lower, but the wall is automatically destroyed by a disintegrate spell of any level or by contact with a rod of cancellation or sphere of annihilation.

Heightened (+2) The Hit Points of the wall increases by 20.

Crushing Despair.name: Crushing Despair
Crushing Despair.description:
You inflict despair on creatures in the area. The effects for each creature are determined by its Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success For 1 round, the creature can't use reactions and must attempt another save at the start of its turn; on a failure, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for that turn as it sobs uncontrollably.

Failure As success, but the duration is 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is automatically @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute.

Heightened (7th) The area increases to a 60-foot cone.

Hallucination.name: Hallucination
Hallucination.description:
The target consistently detects one thing as another, can't detect something that's there, or detects something that's not there, though it doesn't alter their beliefs. You choose which of these effects applies, and you determine the specifics of the hallucination. For example, you could make the target see all elves as humans, be unable to detect the presence of their brother, see their beloved pocket watch on their person even when it isn't, or see a tower in the center of town. The target can attempt an initial Will save, with effects below. They also receive a Will save to disbelieve the hallucination every time they Seek or directly interact with the hallucination. For example, the target could attempt to disbelieve the hallucination each time they interacted with an elf, bumped into their brother accidentally, tried to check their pocket watch, or studied the tower. The target can attempt to disbelieve with a large circumstance bonus in situations determined by the GM, such as if the target attempted to climb the nonexistent tower.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature perceives what you chose until it disbelieves, but it knows what the hallucination is.

Failure The creature perceives what you chose until it disbelieves.

Critical Failure The creature perceives what you chose until it disbelieves, and it trusts its false senses, taking a -4 circumstance penalty to saves to disbelieve.

Heightened (6th) Choose to either target up to 10 creatures or change the spell's duration to until the next time you make your daily preparations.

Heightened (8th) Choose to either target any number of creatures or change the spell's duration to unlimited.

Shadow Siphon.name: Shadow Siphon
Shadow Siphon.description:
Trigger A spell or magical effect deals damage.

Exchanging material energy with that of the Shadow Plane, you transform the triggering spell into a partially illusory version of itself. Attempt to counteract the target spell. If the attempt is successful, any creatures that would be damaged by the spell instead take only half as much damage, but the spell otherwise works as normal. Treat shadow siphon's counteract rank as 2 higher for this attempt.

Telepathic Bond.name: Telepathic Bond
Telepathic Bond.description: The targets can communicate telepathically with any or all of the other targets from any point on the same planet.

Blink.name: Blink
Blink.description:
You blink quickly between the Material Plane and the Ethereal Plane. You gain resistance 5 to all damage (except force). You can Sustain the Spell to vanish and reappear 10 feet away in a random direction determined by the GM; the movement doesn't trigger reactions. At the end of your turn, you vanish and reappear as above.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ZlsuhS9J0S3PuvCO]{Spell Effect: Blink}

Heightened (+2) The resistance increases by 3.

Dimension Door.name: Dimension Door
Dimension Door.description:
Opening a door that bypasses normal space, you instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to a clear space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you-even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container-the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Veil.name: Veil
Veil.description:
You disguise the targets as other creatures of the same body shape and roughly similar height (within 6 inches) and weight (within 50 pounds). The disguise can hide the targets' identities or let them appear to be of another ancestry, but it's not precise enough to impersonate specific individuals. The spell doesn't change voice, scent, or mannerisms. You choose the disguise for each target; for example, you could make one target appear to be a dwarf and another an elf. Casting veil counts as setting up a disguise for the purpose of the Impersonate action. It allows the target to ignore any circumstance penalties they might take for being disguised as dissimilar creatures, and it gives the targets a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to prevent others from seeing through their disguises, and add their level even if untrained. You can Dismiss any or all of these disguises.

Heightened (5th) The spell also disguises the targets' voices and scents; it gains the auditory and olfactory traits.

Heightened (7th) The targets can appear as any creature of the same size, even specific individuals. You must have seen an individual to reproduce their appearance. The spell also disguises the targets' voices and scents; it gains the auditory and olfactory traits.

Dirge of Doom.name: Dirge of Doom
Dirge of Doom.description: Foes within the area are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}. They can't reduce their Frightened value below 1 while they remain in the area.

Haste.name: Haste
Haste.description:
Magic empowers the target to act faster. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition and can use the extra action each round only for Strike and Stride actions.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 6 creatures.

Mind Reading.name: Mind Reading
Mind Reading.description:
With a cursory mental touch, you attempt to read the target's mind. It must attempt a Will save. The target then becomes temporarily immune to your mind reading for 1 hour.

Critical Success The target perceives vague surface thoughts from you when you Cast the Spell.

Success You find out whether the target's Intelligence modifier is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Failure You perceive vague surface thoughts from the target when you Cast the Spell, and you find out whether its Intelligence modifier is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Critical Failure As failure, and for the duration of the spell, you can Sustain the Spell to detect the target's surface thoughts again. The target doesn't receive any additional saves.

Slow.name: Slow
Slow.description:
You dilate the flow of time around the target, slowing its actions.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 1 minute.

Heightened (6th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

See Invisibility.name: See Invisibility
See Invisibility.description:
You can see @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} creatures and objects. They appear to you as translucent shapes, and they are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to you.

Heightened (5th) The spell has a duration of 8 hours.

Shatter.name: Shatter
Shatter.description:
A high-frequency sonic attack shatters a nearby object. You deal 2d10 sonic damage to the object, ignoring the object's Hardness if it is 4 or lower.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10, and the Hardness the spell ignores increases by 2.

Silence.name: Silence
Silence.description:
The target makes no sound, preventing creatures from noticing it using hearing or other senses alone. The target can't use sonic attacks, nor can it use actions with the auditory trait. This prevents it from casting spells that include verbal components.

Heightened (4th) The spell effect emanates from the touched creature, silencing all sound in or passing through a 10- foot radius and preventing any auditory and sonic effects in the affected area. While within the radius, creatures are subject to the same effects as the target. Depending upon the position of the effect, a creature might notice the lack of sound reaching it (blocking off the noise coming from a party, for example).

Triple Time.name: Triple Time
Triple Time.description:
You dance at a lively tempo, speeding your allies' movement. You and all allies in the area gain a +10-foot status bonus to all Speeds for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.HtaDbgTIzdiTiKLX]{Spell Effect: Triple Time}

Charm.name: Charm
Charm.description:
To the target, your words are honey and your visage seems bathed in a dreamy haze. It must attempt a Will save, with a +4 circumstance bonus if you or your allies recently threatened it or used hostile actions against it.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you use hostile actions against the target, the spell ends. When the spell ends, the target doesn't necessarily realize it was charmed unless its friendship with you or the actions you convinced it to take clash with its expectations, meaning you could potentially convince the target to continue being your friend via mundane means.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and aware you tried to charm it.

Success The target is unaffected but thinks your spell was something harmless instead of charm, unless it identifies the spell.

Failure The target's attitude becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{Friendly} toward you. If it was Friendly, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v44P3WUcU1j0115l]{Helpful}. It can't use hostile actions against you.

Critical Failure The target's attitude becomes Helpful toward you, and it can't use hostile actions against you.

Heightened (4th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations.

Heightened (8th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Counter Performance.name: Counter Performance
Counter Performance.description:
Trigger You or an ally within 60 feet rolls a saving throw against an auditory or visual effect.

Your performance protects you and your allies. Roll a Performance check for a type you know: an auditory performance if the trigger was auditory, or a visual one for a visual trigger. You and allies in the area can use the better result between your Performance check and the saving throw.

Dancing Lights.name: Dancing Lights
Dancing Lights.description: You create up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 feet apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move any number of lights up to 60 feet. Each light must remain within 120 feet of you and within 10 feet of all others, or it winks out.

Detect Magic.name: Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies.

You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower level than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the school of magic for the highest-level effect within range that the spell detects. If multiple effects are equally strong, the GM determines which you learn.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd level, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-level magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Ghost Sound.name: Ghost Sound
Ghost Sound.description:
You create an auditory illusion of simple sounds that has a maximum volume equal to four normal humans shouting. The sounds emanate from a square you designate within range. You can't create intelligible words or other intricate sounds (such as music).

Heightened (3rd) The range increases to 60 feet.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 120 feet.

Inspire Courage.name: Inspire Courage
Inspire Courage.description:
You inspire yourself and your allies with words or tunes of encouragement. You and all allies in the area gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, damage rolls, and saves against fear effects.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.beReeFroAx24hj83]{Spell Effect: Courageous Anthem}

Lingering Composition.name: Lingering Composition
Lingering Composition.description:
You add a flourish to your composition to extend its benefits. If your next action is to cast a cantrip composition with a duration of 1 round, attempt a Performance check. The DC is usually a standard-difficulty DC of a level equal to the highest-level target of your composition, but the GM can assign a different DC based on the circumstances. The effect depends on the result of your check.

Critical Success The composition lasts 4 rounds.

Success The composition lasts 3 rounds.

Failure The composition lasts 1 round, but you don't spend the Focus Point for casting this spell.

Read Aura.name: Read Aura
Read Aura.description:
You focus on the target object, opening your mind to perceive magical auras. When the casting is complete, you know whether that item is magical, and if it is, you learn the school of magic.

If the object is illusory, you detect this only if the effect's level is lower than the rank of your read aura spell.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to 10 objects.

Heightened (6th) You can target any number of objects.

Sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
Sanctuary.description:
You ward a creature with protective energy that deters enemy attacks. Creatures attempting to attack the target must attempt a Will save each time. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends.

Critical Success Sanctuary ends.

Success The creature can attempt its attack and any other attacks against the target this turn.

Failure The creature can't attack the target and wastes the action. It can't attempt further attacks against the target this turn.

Critical Failure The creature wastes the action and can't attempt to attack the target for the rest of sanctuary's duration.

Soothe.name: Soothe
Soothe.description:
You grace the target's mind, boosting its mental defenses and healing its wounds. The target regains 1d10+4 Hit Points when you Cast the Spell and gains a +2 status bonus to saves against mental effects for the duration.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.nkk4O5fyzrC0057i]{Spell Effect: Soothe}

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing increases by 1d10+4.

Telekinetic Projectile.name: Telekinetic Projectile
Telekinetic Projectile.description:
You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage-as appropriate for the object you hurled-equal to 1d6 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Ventriloquism.name: Ventriloquism
Ventriloquism.description:
Whenever you speak or make any other sound vocally, you can make your vocalization seem to originate from somewhere else within 60 feet, and you can change that apparent location freely as you vocalize. Any creature that hears the sound can attempt to disbelieve your illusion.

Heightened (2nd) The spell's duration increases to 1 hour, and you can also change the tone, quality, and other aspects of your voice. Before a creature can attempt to disbelieve your illusion, it must actively attempt a Perception check or otherwise use actions to interact with the sound.

+3 Greater Striking Erhu Bow.name: +3 Greater Striking Erhu Bow
+3 Greater Striking Erhu Bow.description: Razu wields his instrument's unique rune- enchanted bow as a deadly weapon. His decades of training with the item allow him to augment it with his own battle cries so that it also deals sonic damage. By attaching the bow's case to its end, he can change the weapon's damage to piercing and use the bow much like a short spear. Any other creature who wields the erhu bow does not deal sonic damage with it, but the weapon otherwise possesses the traits listed above. If sold without its runes, the bow is worth 50 gp.

Studded Leather Armor.name: Studded Leather Armor
Studded Leather Armor.description: This leather armor is reinforced with metal studs and sometimes small metal plates, providing most of the flexibility of leather armor with more robust protection.

Greater Maestro's Instrument (Erhu).name: Greater Maestro's Instrument (Erhu)
Greater Maestro's Instrument (Erhu).description:
A maestro's instrument can be crafted in the form of any variety of handheld musical instruments. A maestro's instrument grants you a +3 item bonus to Performance checks while playing music with the instrument.

Activate—Charming Performance 2 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You play the instrument, causing it to cast a 8th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vLA0q0WOK2YPuJs6]{Charm} spell with DC 38.

Craft Requirements You must supply a casting of charm of the appropriate rank.

Potion of Tongues.name: Potion of Tongues
Potion of Tongues.description: This sour potion enlivens your tongue with unusual flavors and uncommon eloquence, allowing you to speak and understand all languages for 4 hours after you drink it. This doesn't allow you to read these languages in their written form.

Truesight Potion.name: Truesight Potion
Truesight Potion.description: Upon drinking this clear, refreshing potion, you can see things as they actually are. You gain the benefits of a 7th level @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uqlxMQQeSGWEVjki]{Truesight} spell that has a counteract modifier of [[/r 1d20+25]].

Bow Basher.name: Bow Basher
Bow Basher.description: Razu wields his instrument's unique rune- enchanted bow as a deadly weapon. His decades of training with the item allow him to augment it with his own battle cries so that it also deals sonic damage. By attaching the bow's case to its end, he can change the weapon's damage to piercing and use the bow much like a short spear. Any other creature who wields the erhu bow does not deal sonic damage with it, but the weapon otherwise possesses the traits listed above. If sold without its runes, the bow is worth 50 gp.

Incredible Volume.name: Incredible Volume
Incredible Volume.description: Razu's auditory effects that normally have a range 60 feet or less or an emanation area with a radius of 60 feet or less instead have a range or radius of 300 feet. His auditory effects that normally have a range of greater than 60 feet or an emanation area with a radius of greater than 60 feet instead have a range or radius of 1,200 feet (unless it was already farther). His performances are audible up to 10 miles away.

Phantom Orchestra.name: Phantom Orchestra
Phantom Orchestra.description:
You orchestrate an invisible ensemble of lost sounds captured inside errant breezes across the Plane of Air, and you can direct this symphony to attack foes within range. The sounds materialize and manifest as directed, appearing as silhouetted instruments and musicians that dance and bob in the wind.

When you Cast the Spell, a captured breath of ephemeral music explodes in a great crescendo, appearing in a space you choose within range. On subsequent rounds, the first time you Sustain the Spell each round, you can move your conjured melody to a space within range (if needed) and create another explosion of music.

Each explosion of sound from the phantom orchestra deals 8d6 sonic damage to all creatures in a 10-foot burst (basic Fortitude save). The phantom orchestra doesn't take up space, grant flanking, or have any other attributes a creature would.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Rivka (Mogaru).name: Rivka (Mogaru)
Rivka (Mogaru).publicNotes:
Rivkas are parasitic monsters that cling to the sides of kaiju. In their natural form, they resemble giant cockroaches with eight razor-like legs and two mouths-one between two vicious pincers plus a second, much larger mouth on their abdomen. With this secondary mouth they feed off the primordial energy of whichever kaiju they've latched onto.

In the wake of a kaiju attack, a rivka detaches from its host and wades into the disaster zone to prey on the unsuspecting populace by presenting itself as an emissary of the kaiju and demanding tribute. According to this cruel charlatan, only sacrifices of blood and gold can appease their master-though of course the rivka absconds with these offerings before the gifts ever reach the kaiju (such tributes would mean little to the kaiju anyway). Particularly heinous rivkas search the rubble for dead victims to impersonate, magically adopting the visage of a beloved city elder or priest in order to stoke the citizens' paranoia.

Drinking kaiju blood has a strange effect on a rivka's anatomy, enriching both its defensive and offensive capabilities with the primal energy of its host. Other creatures have attempted to drink kaiju blood and replicate this phenomenon, always to terrible effect. Clearly rivkas have coevolved with kaiju in order to metabolize their ancient blood.

Charm (At Will).name: Charm (At Will)
Charm (At Will).description:
To the target, your words are honey and your visage seems bathed in a dreamy haze. It must attempt a Will save, with a +4 circumstance bonus if you or your allies recently threatened it or used hostile actions against it.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you use hostile actions against the target, the spell ends. When the spell ends, the target doesn't necessarily realize it was charmed unless its friendship with you or the actions you convinced it to take clash with its expectations, meaning you could potentially convince the target to continue being your friend via mundane means.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and aware you tried to charm it.

Success The target is unaffected but thinks your spell was something harmless instead of charm, unless it identifies the spell.

Failure The target's attitude becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{Friendly} toward you. If it was Friendly, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v44P3WUcU1j0115l]{Helpful}. It can't use hostile actions against you.

Critical Failure The target's attitude becomes Helpful toward you, and it can't use hostile actions against you.

Heightened (4th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations.

Heightened (8th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Illusory Disguise.name: Illusory Disguise
Illusory Disguise.description:
You create an illusion that causes you to appear as another creature of the same body shape, and with roughly similar height (within 6 inches) and weight (within 50 pounds), as yourself. The disguise is typically good enough to hide your identity, but not to impersonate a specific individual. The spell doesn't change your voice, scent, or mannerisms. You can change the appearance of your clothing and worn items, such as making your armor look like a dress. Held items are unaffected, and any worn item you remove returns to its true appearance.

Casting illusory disguise counts as setting up a disguise for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.k5nW4jGyXD0Oq9LR]{Impersonate} use of Deception; it ignores any circumstance penalties you might take for disguising yourself as a dissimilar creature, it gives you a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to prevent others from seeing through your disguise, and you add your level even if you're untrained. You can Dismiss this spell.

Heightened (2nd) The spell also disguises your voice and scent, and it gains the auditory and olfactory traits.

Heightened (3rd) You can appear as any creature of the same size, even a specific individual. You must have seen an individual to take on their appearance. The spell also disguises your voice and scent, and it gains the auditory and olfactory traits.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{Spell Effect: Illusory Disguise}

Kaiju Blood.name: Kaiju Blood
Kaiju Blood.description: Each rivka gains resistances and offensive powers by feasting on the primordial blood of a kaiju. The type of damage the rivka resists and the type of damage dealt by its Kaiju Ray depend on the kaiju it last fed upon. Some of the most typical rivkas include those that feed on Cimurlian (cold), Kujiba (negative), Igroon (acid), Mogaru (fire), or Yorak (electricity).

Eviscerate.name: Eviscerate
Eviscerate.description:
Requirements The rivka has not attacked yet this turn

Effect The rivka lashes out with four of its razor-like claws. It makes four Strikes: the first at its highest attack bonus, the next two with a -4 penalty to their attack rolls, and the last one with a -8 penalty. This ability counts as four Strikes for the purpose of its multiple attack penalty.

Kaiju Ray.name: Kaiju Ray
Kaiju Ray.description: The rivka opens its maw and projects a @Template[line|distance:60] of primal energy that deals @Damage[14d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:32|basic|options:area-effect|traits:fire] save). The type of damage dealt by the ray depends on which kaiju the rivka has most recently fed from (see above). The rivka can't use Kaiju Ray again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Kaiju Ray]]{1d4 rounds}.

Shadow Yai.name: Shadow Yai
Shadow Yai.publicNotes: Oni who assume the form of shadow giants are known as shadow yais. Many shadow yais crave the pleasures of music and go to great lengths to secure bardic or musically inclined supplicants. Smaller beings who refuse to submit to a shadow yai are subject to painful, drawn out, and strangely beautiful deaths, for a shadow yai has a special way of evoking melodic cries and screams from their victims: a veritable symphony of pain. Individuals of particular musical skill who accompany a shadow yai can find the experience extremely lucrative and enriching-as long as they don't run afoul of their liege.

Shadow Walk.name: Shadow Walk
Shadow Walk.description: You access the Shadow Plane, using its warped nature to spread your travels. The targets enter the edge of the Shadow Plane where it borders the Material Plane. Targets can't see the Material Plane while on the Shadow Plane (although elements of that plane can sometimes be a hazy reflection of the Material Plane). While on the Shadow Plane, the targets are exposed to potential encounters with that plane's denizens. The shadows on the border between the planes bend space, speeding up your movement with respect to the Material Plane. Every 3 minutes the targets travel along this border, they move as far as they would through the Material Plane in 1 hour. At any point, a target can Dismiss the spell's effects, although this affects only that target. The shadow bending is inexact, so when the spell ends, the targets appear roughly 1 mile from their intended location on the Material Plane (though those who are traveling together and Dismiss the spell at the same point on the Plane of Shadow appear together).

Enthrall (At Will).name: Enthrall (At Will)
Enthrall (At Will).description:
Your words fascinate your targets. You speak or sing without interruption throughout the casting and duration. Targets who notice your speech or song might give their undivided attention; each target must attempt a Will save. The GM might grant a circumstance bonus (to a maximum of +4) if the target is of an opposing religion, ancestry, or political leaning, or is otherwise unlikely to agree with what you're saying.

Each creature that comes within range has to attempt a save when you Sustain the Spell. If you're speaking, enthrall gains the linguistic trait.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and notices that you tried to use magic.

Success The target needn't pay attention but doesn't notice you tried to use magic (it might notice others are enthralled).

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with you. It can attempt another Will save if it witnesses actions or speech with which it disagrees. If it succeeds, it's no longer Fascinated and is temporarily immune for 1 hour. If the target is subject to a hostile act, or if another creature succeeds at a Diplomacy or Intimidation check against it, the fascination ends immediately.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target can't attempt a save to end the fascination if it disagrees with you.

Darkness.name: Darkness
Darkness.description:
You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Invisibility (at will, self only).name: Invisibility (at will, self only)
Invisibility (at will, self only).description:
Cloaked in illusion, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

Charm.name: Charm
Charm.description:
To the target, your words are honey and your visage seems bathed in a dreamy haze. It must attempt a Will save, with a +4 circumstance bonus if you or your allies recently threatened it or used hostile actions against it.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you use hostile actions against the target, the spell ends. When the spell ends, the target doesn't necessarily realize it was charmed unless its friendship with you or the actions you convinced it to take clash with its expectations, meaning you could potentially convince the target to continue being your friend via mundane means.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and aware you tried to charm it.

Success The target is unaffected but thinks your spell was something harmless instead of charm, unless it identifies the spell.

Failure The target's attitude becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{Friendly} toward you. If it was Friendly, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v44P3WUcU1j0115l]{Helpful}. It can't use hostile actions against you.

Critical Failure The target's attitude becomes Helpful toward you, and it can't use hostile actions against you.

Heightened (4th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations.

Heightened (8th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Charm (957G).description:

You can Dismiss the spell. If you use hostile actions against the target, the spell ends. When the spell ends, the target doesn't necessarily realize it was charmed unless its friendship with you or the actions you convinced it to take clash with its expectations, meaning you could potentially convince the target to continue being your friend via mundane means.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and aware you tried to charm it.

Success The target is unaffected but thinks your spell was something harmless instead of charm, unless it identifies the spell.

Failure The target's attitude becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{Friendly} toward you. If it was Friendly, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v44P3WUcU1j0115l]{Helpful}. It can't use hostile actions against you.

Heightened (4th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations.

Command.name: Command
Command.description:
You shout a command that's hard to ignore. You can command the target to approach you, run away (as if it had the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition), release what it's holding, drop @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, or stand in place. It can't Delay or take any reactions until it has obeyed your command. The effects depend on the target's Will save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure For the first action on its next turn, the creature must use a single action to do as you command.

Critical Failure The target must use all its actions on its next turn to obey your command.

Heightened (5th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Glaive.name: Glaive
Glaive.description: This polearm consists of a long, single-edged blade on the end of a 7-foot pole. It is extremely effective at delivering lethal cuts at a distance.

Shadow Step.name: Shadow Step
Shadow Step.description:
Requirements The shadow yai is in an area of dim light or darkness or is standing in the shadow of any Large or larger object

Effect The shadow yai instantly teleports to another location that's in dim light or darkness or to a space that's in the shadow of any Large or larger object within 60 feet.

Change Shape.name: Change Shape
Change Shape.description:
The shadow yai takes on the appearance of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.JSKZryHwf0Ggq8KR]{Shadow Giant}. This doesn't change its Speed or Strike attack and damage.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

Shadow Touch.name: Shadow Touch
Shadow Touch.description:
A shadow yai's touch harms their target's spiritual essence in addition to its body. A creature hit by the shadow yai's fist Strike must attempt a @Check[will|dc:36] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes @Damage[2d6[void]] damage.

Failure The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} and takes @Damage[3d6[void]] damage. As long as the creature is drained as a result of this ability, it loses the ability to speak above a whisper. When the creature attempts to Cast a Spell with a verbal component, it must succeed at a flat check or the spell is disrupted. The DC of this flat check is equal to 5 plus the creature's drained value (for example, DC 7 if the creature is drained 2).

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and takes @Damage[6d6[void]] damage.

Penumbral Disguise.name: Penumbral Disguise
Penumbral Disguise.description:
You wrap the target in shadows, granting it a +1 status bonus to Stealth checks to Hide while in dim light or darkness. In addition, the shadows mask the target's features. While the target is in dim light or darkness, other creatures must succeed at a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action against the spell's DC to discern details about its appearance. For example, without using Seek, other creatures can determine the target's general shape (such as humanoid), but they must Seek to determine the target's precise appearance. Creatures with darkvision can still see the target and its features normally. The target's normal appearance is revealed in bright light.

Heightened (4th) The status bonus is +2. Creatures with darkvision can no longer discern details about the target while the target is in dim light or darkness without Seeking, though creatures with greater darkvision can still determine these details.

Heightened (6th) As 4th rank, except the status bonus is +3, and creatures without darkvision can't determine even general details about the target while the target is in dim light or darkness unless they successfully Seek the target; these creatures see a vague shadow instead. Even on a successful Seek, they only determine general features, though they can see details on a critical success.

Heightened (8th) As 6th rank, except the status bonus is +4, and even creatures with greater darkvision must Seek to discern details about the target while the target is in dim light or darkness.

Shadow Raid.name: Shadow Raid
Shadow Raid.description:
You spin illusions of flying shadows throughout the area. The shadows strike and cavort, harming your foes and blocking their vision with twisting shadow. Enemies in the area when you Cast the Spell take 6d8 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, with a @Check[reflex|basic|traits:illusion] or @Check[will|basic|traits:illusion] save, as shadows explode into being. You choose the damage type when you Cast the Spell, and each creature chooses the type of save it attempts before it rolls the save. The shadows then persist in the area for 1 minute, dealing [[/r 3d8]] damage of the type you chose to any enemy that ends its turn in the area. All creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to enemies in the area, as the illusory shadows swarm over them and block light.

A creature that spends an action to Seek or otherwise interact with the shadow raid can attempt a Perception check to disbelieve it. On a success, the creature halves the damage it takes from the shadows, and the shadows no longer impede its vision. These benefits last until the spell ends.

Heightened (9th) The initial damage increases by 2d8, and the damage to a creature that ends its turn in the area increases by 1d8 ([[/r 4d8]]).

Shadow Blast.name: Shadow Blast
Shadow Blast.description:
Area varies

Defense @Check[reflex|basic|options:area-effect] or @Check[will|basic|options:area-effect] (target's choice)

You shape the shadow substance of the Netherworld into a blast. Choose @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[acid]|options:area-damage], @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage], @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[cold]|options:area-damage], @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[electricity]|options:area-damage], @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[fire]|options:area-damage], @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[force]|options:area-damage], @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[piercing]|options:area-damage], @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[slashing]|options:area-damage], @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[sonic]|options:area-damage], or @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[spirit]|options:area-damage] damage, and choose a @Template[cone|distance:30], a @Template[burst|distance:15] within 120 feet, or a @Template[line|distance:50]. The blast deals 6d8 damage of the type you chose to each creature in the area.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.

Effect: Dynamic Performance Combat.name: Effect: Dynamic Performance Combat
Effect: Dynamic Performance Combat.description: In order to help players remember these bonuses and the current state of the crowd, consider using a tracker like the one below.

Effect: Double Debilitating Sneak Attack.name: 效果：双重削弱偷袭
Effect: Double Debilitating Sneak Attack.description:
由「双重削弱偷袭」给予

持续 1 轮：目标受到两种你选择的「削弱」状态，而非通常的一种。

Effect: Dualistic Synergy.name: 效果：双方协同
Effect: Dualistic Synergy.description:
由「双重协同」给予

当你与盟友配合行动时，下次打击伤害骰获得 +2 项目加值，持续到本回合结束。
